title: Spicy Korean Macaroni Stir Fry
description: A simple and spicy stir fry recipe using Korean chili flakes and macaroni.

ingredients.name: Vibrant Hei
ingredients.notes: any variety of vibrant hei will work

instructions: Cook the macaroni according to the package instructions until al dente.
In a large wok or frying pan, heat 1 tablespoon of oil over medium-high heat.
Add the vibrant hei and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes until slightly browned.
Add the Korean chili flakes and stir-fry for another minute.
Add the cooked macaroni to the wok and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes until combined with the hei and chili flakes.
Add the sujebi (if using) and stir-fry for another minute.
